name: capyquest
description: A pixel-art idle clicker RPG about a very relaxed capybara.
//: The GAME has no dependencies and no build step: it is plain static files, and nothing in src/ imports anything from node_modules. This file exists so Node treats src/ as ES modules when running the test suite; the vm-modules flag is for tests/modules.test.js, which parses every source file — including main.js, which needs a DOM and so is never imported by anything else.
//devDependencies: playwright-core drives tests/browser/run.mjs, which opens the real page and checks what the console prints and what size things come out — the class of bug that shipped past a green unit suite four times in v3. jsqr decodes the QR codes src/render/qr.js draws: a decoder written alongside an encoder shares its assumptions and read a broken code back perfectly, so the check has to come from somebody else's implementation. Both are test harness, not runtime dependencies: `npm test` and the game itself both work with node_modules deleted.
